EBB Table Service 0.1.76-rc

Approval roles now follow the business policy explicitly: the selected POS session's cashier or an Approvers-group member can authorize a waiter joining that POS. Environment changes, privileged order changes and other supervisor actions require Approvers-group authorization. Cashiers do not need Approvers membership for their cashier duties.

Updated approval lists, PIN labels and explanations distinguish these roles. Requires the matching Odoo waiter approval-policy correction. Orders, saved Environment Settings and API keys are retained by an in-place upgrade.
